clues.q: In Genesis 2, God made the first woman from this part of Adam’s body
In Exodus 2, baby Moses was hidden in a basket among the reeds by the bank of this river
In Genesis 28, Jacob dreamed of this, set up on the earth and reaching to heaven, with angels going up and down on it
In Exodus 3, Moses was tending the flock of his father-in-law, this priest of Midian, when God called him
In Genesis 14, this king of Salem and “priest of the most high God” brought out bread and wine and blessed Abram
In Luke 2, the newborn Jesus was laid in this feeding trough because there was no room at the inn
In Luke 2, the twelve-year-old Jesus was found here, sitting among the teachers, listening and asking questions
In Matthew 2, Joseph took Mary and the child Jesus to which country to escape King Herod?
In Matthew, these visitors from the east followed a star and brought gold, frankincense, and myrrh
At the Transfiguration, Jesus was seen talking with these two great Old Testament figures
This 2004 Chris Tomlin anthem declares “Age to age He stands, and time is in His hands”
clues.a: What is “How Great Is Our God”?

clues.q: Lauren Daigle’s 2018 hit says God calls her loved “when I can’t feel a thing”
Hillsong United’s 2013 song begins “You call me out upon the waters, the great unknown where feet may fail”
Matt Redman’s Grammy-winning 2011 song includes the line “The sun comes up, it’s a new day dawning”
This Nigerian gospel singer wrote and first recorded “Way Maker,” later sung by churches worldwide
In VeggieTales, Bob is a tomato and his best pal Larry is this vegetable
This filmmaker created and directs The Chosen, the multi-season series about Jesus and his followers
On Touched by an Angel, Della Reese played Tess, the supervisor of this angel played by Roma Downey
This Italian director made the 1977 TV miniseries Jesus of Nazareth
In this 2016 film, Joseph Fiennes plays a Roman tribune assigned to investigate Jesus’s empty tomb
This 13th-century Italian saint, founder of an order of friars, is famous for preaching to the birds
In 563, this Irish monk founded a monastery on the Scottish island of Iona
Johannes Gutenberg printed his famous Bible in the 1450s in this German city on the Rhine
This Byzantine emperor had the great church of Hagia Sophia rebuilt, completing it in 537
This 13th-century Dominican theologian wrote the massive Summa Theologiae
In April 2019, a fire toppled the spire of this famous Gothic cathedral in Paris
In 2013, Jorge Mario Bergoglio was elected pope; he came from this South American country
In February 2023, a chapel service at Asbury University became a round-the-clock revival in this U.S. state
Archbishop Desmond Tutu chaired this South African commission whose public hearings began in 1996
clues.a: What is the Truth and Reconciliation Commission?

clues.q: In 1993, Pope John Paul II drew huge crowds to this Colorado city for World Youth Day
In Exodus, God gave Moses this many commandments on the tablets of stone
In Genesis, this many people (Noah, his wife, his three sons, and their wives) rode out the flood in the ark
In Judges 7, how many men did God tell Gideon to keep after testing them at the water?
In Genesis 29, Jacob agreed to work this many years for Laban in order to marry Rachel
In Genesis, Methuselah lived this many years
In Genesis, he answered God, “Am I my brother’s keeper?”
Serving under the priest Eli, this boy answered the Lord’s call in the night: “Speak; for thy servant heareth”
Moses’ successor declared, “As for me and my house, we will serve the Lord”
After losing nearly everything, this man said, “The Lord gave, and the Lord hath taken away; blessed be the name of the Lord”
Holding baby Jesus in the Temple, this devout old man said, “Lord, now lettest thou thy servant depart in peace”
This singer’s 1991 album Heart in Motion included the pop hit “Baby Baby”
This gospel artist teamed with God’s Property on the 1997 hit “Stomp”
This singer-songwriter released the 1983 classic “Friends” and the 2001 live album Worship
Simple repeated chants like “Ubi Caritas” and “Bless the Lord, My Soul” come from this ecumenical community in Burgundy, France
Cory Asbury’s 2017 Bethel Music hit celebrates the “overwhelming, never-ending” love of God described by this adjective
In this CBN animated series, a magical Bible whisks kids back in time into Bible stories
The 2013 miniseries The Bible first aired on this cable channel
This animator co-created VeggieTales and provides the voice of Bob the Tomato
In the 2018 film I Can Only Imagine, Dennis Quaid plays the father of this MercyMe singer
This studio released the animated musical Joseph: King of Dreams straight to video in 2000
This pope, who served from 590 to 604, sent the monk Augustine to bring Christianity to the English
These ninth-century brothers from Thessalonica were missionaries to the Slavic peoples
This 6th-century Italian monk wrote the famous Rule followed by many Western monasteries
Pointed arches, flying buttresses, and stained glass mark this style of medieval cathedrals like Chartres
This lavishly illuminated Gospel book, made by Irish monks around 800, is kept at Trinity College Dublin
clues.a: What is the Book of Kells?

In 2010, Mary MacKillop was canonized as the first saint from this country
In 2014, Pope Francis declared two predecessors saints: John XXIII and this Polish pope
In 2013, this former oil-industry executive became Archbishop of Canterbury
In 2022, Anglican bishops from around the world met in Canterbury for this roughly once-a-decade gathering

Isaac’s wife, found at a well by Abraham’s servant?
Jacob’s beloved wife, mother of Joseph and Benjamin?
Sea the Israelites crossed on dry ground?
Woman who discovered the secret of Samson’s strength?
Ruth’s mother-in-law?
Days Jesus fasted in the wilderness?
Pharisee who came to Jesus by night in John 3?
Sister of Mary who was busy with serving?
Garden where Jesus prayed before his arrest?
Paul’s companion who sang hymns with him in a Philippi jail?
Cupbearer who led the rebuilding of Jerusalem’s walls?
Moses’ brother who spoke for him to Pharaoh?
Moses’ sister who led the women in song after the sea crossing?
Jacob’s twin brother?
Woman of Jericho who hid the Israelite spies?
Mother of John the Baptist?
Mother of King Solomon?
Idol the Israelites made while Moses was on the mountain?
Instrument young David played to soothe King Saul?
Tree Jesus cursed for having no fruit?

Who said “I am the way, the truth, and the life”?

clues.q: Proverbs 15 says, “A soft answer turneth away” this
clues.hint: A strong, fiery emotion.

clues.q: Proverbs 31 says the price of a virtuous woman is far above these red gems
clues.hint: July’s birthstone.

clues.q: Proverbs 3 says, “Trust in the Lord with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own” this
clues.hint: What you have when you finally “get it.”

clues.q: Proverbs 6 tells the sluggard to go to this tiny creature and “consider her ways, and be wise”
clues.hint: A picnic pest that works in colonies.

clues.q: One psalm of exile begins “By the rivers of” this city, “there we sat down, yea, we wept”
clues.hint: Nebuchadnezzar’s capital.

clues.q: In Matthew 4, Jesus called these two fishermen brothers, sons of Zebedee, from mending their nets
clues.hint: Jesus nicknamed them “Sons of Thunder.”

clues.q: In John 14, this apostle asked, “Lord, shew us the Father, and it sufficeth us”
clues.hint: Shares a name with Alexander the Great’s father.

clues.q: Luke’s Gospel distinguishes the apostle Simon from Simon Peter by calling him by this label
clues.hint: Today the word means a fanatic.

clues.q: In Acts 1, lots were cast and this man was chosen to replace Judas among the Twelve
clues.hint: The other candidate was Joseph called Barsabas.

clues.q: In John 1, Jesus told this man, “When thou wast under the fig tree, I saw thee”; he is often identified with Bartholomew
clues.hint: Philip brought him, saying “Come and see.”

clues.q: Hillsong Church began in 1983 in the suburbs of this Australian city
clues.hint: Home of a famous harbour opera house.

clues.q: This Hillsong worship leader wrote the 1994 anthem “Shout to the Lord”
clues.hint: Her surname starts with Z.

clues.q: Elevation Worship is the music ministry of Elevation Church, based in which North Carolina city?
clues.hint: Nicknamed the Queen City.

clues.q: Bethel Music grew out of Bethel Church in this Northern California city
clues.hint: Near Mount Shasta, on the Sacramento River.

clues.q: This English songwriter wrote the worship favorite “Here I Am to Worship” around 2000
clues.hint: First name short for Timothy.

clues.q: This actor plays Jesus in the series The Chosen
clues.hint: Shares a first name with David’s best friend.

clues.q: Early VeggieTales episodes ended with a Bible verse from this countertop computer
clues.hint: Named after keyboard letters.

clues.q: Touched by an Angel aired from 1994 to 2003 on this TV network
clues.hint: Its logo is an eye.

clues.q: The original 1981 Superbook anime was produced with CBN in this country
clues.hint: Land of the rising sun.

clues.q: This English actor played Jesus in the 1977 miniseries Jesus of Nazareth
clues.hint: Shares a surname with Scouting founder Baden-___.

clues.q: On Christmas Day in 800, Pope Leo III crowned this king as emperor
clues.hint: King of the Franks.

clues.q: This 12th-century German abbess composed music, wrote on medicine, and recorded her visions
clues.hint: Rhineland nun; named a Doctor of the Church in 2012.

clues.q: Around 731, this English monk finished his Ecclesiastical History of the English People
clues.hint: Monk of Jarrow, often called “Venerable.”

clues.q: This noblewoman and follower of Francis founded an order of nuns now named for her
clues.hint: Pope Pius XII named her patron saint of television.

clues.q: In the 1380s, this Oxford scholar and his followers produced the first complete English Bible, translated from the Latin
clues.hint: Called the “Morning Star of the Reformation.”

clues.q: In February 2013, this pope announced his resignation, the first pope to step down in about 600 years
clues.hint: Born Joseph Ratzinger.

clues.q: In March 2013, smoke of this color rising from the Sistine Chapel chimney signaled a new pope
clues.hint: Same color as a dove.

clues.q: Crossway first published this English Bible translation in 2001, building on the 1971 text of the Revised Standard Version
clues.a: What is the ESV (English Standard Version)?
clues.hint: Three initials; the last is V.

clues.q: Archbishop Desmond Tutu popularized this colorful nickname for post-apartheid South Africa
clues.hint: Think of the sign of Noah’s covenant.

clues.q: World Youth Day 2016 was held in this Polish city
clues.hint: John Paul II was once its archbishop.

clues.q: In Genesis 11, Abram’s family set out from this city “of the Chaldees”
clues.hint: An ancient Sumerian city in today’s Iraq.

clues.q: In John 11, Jesus raised Lazarus at this village about two miles from Jerusalem
clues.hint: Home of Mary and Martha.

clues.q: God sent Jonah to preach to this great city
clues.hint: Capital of the Assyrian empire.

clues.q: In Acts 21, Paul tells a Roman officer he is a Jew of this city in Cilicia
clues.hint: Today in southern Turkey.

clues.q: Elijah challenged the prophets of Baal to call down fire on this mountain
clues.hint: A ridge near modern Haifa.

clues.q: At the Last Supper, Jesus took bread and a cup of this
clues.hint: Made from grapes.

clues.q: In Exodus 12, this feast’s lamb and unleavened bread recall Israel’s escape from Egypt
clues.hint: Celebrated today with a Seder meal.

clues.q: Along with locusts, what did John the Baptist eat in the wilderness?
clues.hint: Made by bees.

clues.q: In Genesis, Esau sold his birthright to Jacob for bread and a bowl of this
clues.hint: A red pottage made from legumes.

clues.q: In 1 Kings 17, a widow of this town fed Elijah, and her flour and oil did not run out
clues.hint: A Phoenician town near Sidon.

clues.q: This 2019 Bethel Music song, sung by Jenn Johnson, declares “All my life You have been faithful”
clues.hint: Title names a fruit of the Spirit.

clues.q: Carol Cymbala directs this Grammy-winning gospel choir from a New York City church
clues.a: What is the Brooklyn Tabernacle Choir?
clues.hint: Not Manhattan, but across the bridge.

clues.q: This singer-songwriter wrote the 1988 praise anthem “Awesome God”
clues.hint: He also co-wrote “Sometimes by Step.”

clues.q: TobyMac was one-third of this Christian rap-rock trio behind the 1995 album Jesus Freak
clues.hint: Two lowercase letters plus a word.

clues.q: This 2016 Hillsong Worship song, co-written by Brooke Ligertwood, won a Grammy for its praise of Jesus’s name
clues.hint: Opens “You were the Word at the beginning.”

clues.q: Christian Bale plays Moses in this 2014 Ridley Scott film
clues.hint: Ridley Scott also directed Gladiator.

clues.q: In VeggieTales’ “Dave and the Giant Pickle,” young Dave is played by Junior, this kind of vegetable
clues.hint: Green spears, often grilled.

clues.q: This actress co-produced the 2013 miniseries The Bible with her husband, Mark Burnett
clues.hint: Irish-born star of Touched by an Angel.

clues.q: In the 2011 Superbook reboot, Chris and Joy travel with this wisecracking robot
clues.hint: Robot sidekick; name starts with G.

clues.q: Jeffrey Hunter plays Jesus in this 1961 Nicholas Ray epic
clues.hint: A royal title for Jesus from Revelation.

clues.q: This 4th-century bishop of Myra, famed for secret gift-giving, inspired the legend of Santa Claus
clues.hint: His feast day is December 6.

clues.q: Hagia Sophia was built as a cathedral in this city, capital of the Byzantine Empire
clues.hint: Named for the emperor who refounded it.

clues.q: This Spanish priest founded the Order of Preachers, confirmed by the pope in 1216
clues.hint: Thomas Aquinas later joined his order.

clues.q: This English anchoress wrote, “All shall be well, and all shall be well, and all manner of thing shall be well”
clues.hint: She lived walled in a cell beside a church.

clues.q: Founded in 910 in Burgundy, this Benedictine abbey led a major reform of medieval monasteries
clues.hint: A Paris museum of medieval art shares its name.

clues.q: The 2013 conclave that chose Pope Francis met in this chapel
clues.hint: Michelangelo painted its ceiling.

clues.q: London’s Holy Trinity Brompton developed this course introducing Christianity, which spread worldwide in the 1990s
clues.hint: Shares its name with a Greek letter.

clues.q: In 2019, Pope Francis became the first pope to visit the Arabian Peninsula, celebrating Mass in this city
clues.hint: Capital of the United Arab Emirates.

clues.q: In 2011, churches celebrated the 400th anniversary of this English Bible translation
clues.a: What is the King James Version?
clues.hint: Named for a Stuart monarch.

clues.q: Fans crowdfunded The Chosen through this Utah company, later renamed Angel Studios
clues.hint: Earlier known for filtering movies.

Which Christian band recorded the hit “I Can Only Imagine”?

According to Acts 1, from which mount did Jesus ascend into heaven?
Singer Lauren Daigle grew up in which U.S. state?
What does the Greek name “Hagia Sophia” mean?
Who was the mother of the prophet Samuel?

rounds.name: Final Round
rounds.q: In Acts 8, Philip explained a passage of Isaiah to a court official of Queen Candace from this land, then baptized him
rounds.hint: An African kingdom south of Egypt.

rounds.name: Final Round
rounds.q: In this letter, Paul urges believers to put on “the whole armour of God,” including the shield of faith and the sword of the Spirit
rounds.hint: Written to a church in the city of Artemis’s great temple.
